name: listen-no-transcript
desc: Listening item has no transcript/audio - unanswerable

name: read-no-passage
desc: Prompt references a passage/text but none stored - unanswerable

name: visual-no-assets
desc: Image question type with no linked assets

name: answer-out-of-range
desc: answer.index points outside choices array

name: choices-too-few
desc: MCQ-type with fewer than 3 choices

name: option-placeholder
desc: A choice is a literal generator placeholder like "option-4"

name: prompt-answer-leak
desc: Prompt literally contains the quoted correct answer (guessable without skill)

name: prompt-answer-leak-unquoted
desc: English item whose bare-digit correct answer is reprinted inside the prompt

name: prompt-image-placeholder
desc: Prompt describes an image in text "(Image of X)" - no real asset and the description leaks the answer

name: explanation-missing
desc: No explanation at all

name: explanation-template-residue
desc: Leftover generator template text

name: wrong-answer-math
desc: Marked answer contradicts the computed value of the prompt

name: wrong-comparison-answer
desc: Compare X and Y items: marked answer wrong for the numbers

name: reorder-bank-mismatch
desc: Reorder prompt word bank is not a permutation of the answer sentence

name: text-answer-empty
desc: text-answer item has no usable answer text or accepted list

name: dup-option-assets
desc: Two options reference the same image asset (visually identical choices)

name: prompt-placeholder
desc: Prompt contains placeholder tokens (undefined/null/TODO)

name: form-missing-question
desc: Form references a question id that does not exist

name: form-ineligible-question
desc: Form includes a question not eligible for serving (flagged/excluded)

name: form-missing-answerkey
desc: Form question has no entry in answerKey

name: form-answerkey-mismatch
desc: Form answerKey disagrees with the question stored answer

name: form-duplicate-variant
desc: Two questions in the same form share a variant group or identical content

name: duplicate-choices
desc: Two identical choices in one question

name: ambiguous-open-prompt
desc: Open-ended prompt where more than one choice is a plausible true answer - review for quarantine

name: statement-as-question
desc: Declarative statement prompt (no question/blank) with yes-no agreement options - unanswerable without a scene or passage

name: explanation-too-short
desc: Explanation under 20 chars - teaches nothing

name: explanation-mentions-other-answer
desc: Explanation quotes a DIFFERENT choice than the correct answer (heuristic mismatch)

name: explanation-not-vietnamese
desc: Explanation has no Vietnamese characters (untranslated?)

name: explanation-tautology
desc: Explanation only restates "answer fits the theme" without a reason or contrast

name: reorder-trivial
desc: Reorder answer is a single word - nothing to arrange

name: heard-word-not-in-transcript
desc: "Which word did you hear" answer is not spoken in the transcript

name: form-near-dup-content
desc: Same form contains two questions identical modulo names/numbers (same template)

name: form-grade-subject-mismatch
desc: Question grade/subject differs from its form

name: form-blueprint-size
desc: Form question count differs from blueprint targetQuestions

name: form-blueprint-missing
desc: Form references a blueprint that does not exist

name: dup-prompt-same-grade
desc: Identical prompt+answer that can co-appear in one exam (no shared variant_group_id)

name: ambiguous-country-name
desc: Correct answer or prompted term is an ambiguous country name (Congo/Korea/Bosnia...)

name: accented-text
desc: Foreign accent marks (never legal in Vietnamese) in served prompt or choices
